'''John Tingley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 12th at [[August 2000 Las Vegas tournament]] on 5 August 2000, according to John Spadora's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1087">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-las-vegas-8-05-2000-the-mans-reportd1087/ las-vegas-8-05-2000-the-mans-report], DeckTech (John "The Man" Spadora, 5 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-las-vegas-8-05-2000-the-mans-reportd1087/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
